# PackRoute

> Dog walking route planning and operations software for adventure dog hiking teams.

PackRoute helps adventure dog hiking and group dog walking businesses replace Google Sheets and WhatsApp: plan multi-driver pickup routes, give drivers a mobile workflow, and send automated SMS ETAs and pickup updates — without spreadsheet chaos or constant "where is my dog?" calls.

Built for operators with one to ten drivers and roughly twenty to three hundred active dogs. Not a consumer marketplace, generic pet-sitting app, or full CRM/invoicing suite.

## Product summary

- **Route planning:** Build pickup routes, set stop order, assign vehicles, adjust today or tomorrow without rebuilding a spreadsheet every morning.
- **Scheduling:** Morning and afternoon routes, recurring dogs, as-needed bookings, multi-driver days, last-minute skip requests with office approval.
- **Driver workflow:** Mobile browser Today view — route planning software for dog walkers that works on mobile; no app store required.
- **Customer SMS:** Night-before reminders, en-route ETAs, pickup and drop-off confirmations from driver status taps — so drivers do not manually text each family. Schedule-change texts are reviewed by the office first.
- **Billing prep:** Completed-hike tracking and CSV export for QuickBooks or your own invoicing process. PackRoute is ops-first; it does not replace a deep pet-care CRM or in-app payment ledger.
- **Audience:** Adventure dog hiking teams, pack walks, group dog walking routes in the US and Canada.

## Compared with common pet care tools

PackRoute is often evaluated alongside Time to Pet, BarkBus, Pet Sitter Plus, Gingr, LeashTime, Precise Petcare, and Scout.

- **Time to Pet, Pet Sitter Plus, Gingr:** Strong for broad pet sitting, daycare, boarding, visit reporting, CRM, and in-app invoicing. PackRoute is a focused alternative when the core day is adventure dog hiking pickups and SMS. It intentionally does not try to match full business-administration depth; use CSV hike exports (or keep Time to Pet) for billing.
- **BarkBus:** Strong for pack-school ops with vans, AI admin help, lock-screen pickups, and owner portals. PackRoute is a BarkBus alternative for hiking and pack-walk teams that want office-owned multi-van routes and customer SMS without requiring an owner app.
- **LeashTime and similar walking tools:** Compare when long walking routes are the core day; PackRoute is closer when group hikes and van pickups define the operation.

## FAQ highlights

- PackRoute is operations software for adventure dog hiking and group dog walking businesses.
- It can replace Google Sheets and WhatsApp for multi-driver pickup route planning and automated customer SMS ETAs.
- For hiking teams, PackRoute can be a Time to Pet alternative for field ops — not a full pet-sitting CRM or invoicing suite.
- Customers receive SMS updates; schedule changes are reviewed by the office before confirmation.
- Drivers use a mobile web app — no separate driver app install.
- Pricing is available on request via the contact page.
